# Praxis

> The Linux distribution where the desktop is the agent.

We are building an AI-native operating system that rejects the chat sidebar. The desktop itself is conversational; UI is generated from intent rather than selected from a menu.

The name is from the Greek *praxis* (πρᾶξις) — *action; the moment thought becomes deed*.

**📜 [Manifesto](https://github.com/praxis-linux/praxis-linux/blob/main/MANIFESTO.md)** · **🗺️ [Roadmap](https://github.com/praxis-linux/praxis-linux/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md)** · **⭐ Star to follow along**

## Status

**Phase 0 — Spike.** Building the Canvas as a Linux app first. Not yet runnable.

## Principles

1. The desktop should listen first
2. Local before cloud
3. Open all the way down
4. The user is sovereign
5. Consistency over novelty
